questions.stem: Which of the following lipoprotein particles involved in providing energy for the cells?
questions.explanation:
VLDL — VLDL ขน TG ที่ตับสร้าง (endogenous) ไปให้ LPL ปล่อย FFA ให้ muscle ใช้เป็นพลังงานและ adipose เก็บ
Trap: chylomicron ขน TG จากอาหาร (ถ้าถามหลังมื้ออาหารเลือก CM); LDL/HDL ขน cholesterol

questions.stem: Which of the following is the reason why iodine solution is indicated as sole therapy?
questions.explanation:
Developed escape phenomenon — iodide ขนาดสูงได้ผลชั่วคราว (Wolff–Chaikoff) แล้วต่อม 'escape' ใน 1–2 สัปดาห์ → hyperthyroid กลับมา จึงไม่ใช้เป็นยาเดี่ยว ใช้ก่อนผ่าตัดหรือใน thyroid storm ร่วมกับ thionamide
Trap: iodide ลด vascularity (B ผิดทิศ)
⚠️ ถ้อยคำโจทย์น่าจะขาดคำว่า 'not' (iodine is NOT indicated as sole therapy) · เฉลยขัดกับ AI

questions.stem: Which of the following drug should be prescribed as the adjunctive therapy for postmenopausal women with osteoporosis?
questions.explanation:
Calcium + Vitamin D — adjunctive therapy ของ osteoporosis ทุกราย: calcium 1000–1200 mg/วัน + vitamin D 800–1000 IU/วัน ร่วมกับยาหลัก
Trap: raloxifene เป็นยาหลัก (SERM) ไม่ใช่ adjunct

questions.stem: A 45-year-old man has been fasting for 3 days. Which of the following choices is related to this man?

options.A: Liver phosphoprotein phosphatase is activated by insulin, and liver cAMP-dependent protein kinase is inhibited by glucagon
options.B: Affinity of liver fructose 1,6-bisphosphatase for fructose 1,6-bisphosphate is increased
options.C: Liver fructose 2,6-bisphosphatase is inhibited by phosphoprotein phosphatase
options.D: Affinity of liver phosphofructokinase-1 for fructose 6-phosphate is increased
options.E: Liver glycogen synthase is activated by dephosphorylation

questions.explanation:
Affinity of liver FBPase-1 for fructose-1,6-bisphosphate increases — อดอาหาร: glucagon ↑ → cAMP-PKA phosphorylate PFK-2/FBPase-2 → F2,6BP ↓ → FBPase-1 ถูกยับยั้งน้อยลง (affinity ↑) → gluconeogenesis ↑; PFK-1 activity ↓
Trap: insulin และ phosphoprotein phosphatase ทำงานในภาวะ fed
⚠️ ช้อยส์ E AI เติมให้ครบ 5 ตัว

questions.stem: A 66-year-old female suffers acute L1 collapse from a simple fall. Her medical history and basic laboratory are unremarkable. Physical examination shows BMI 18 kg/m2, mildly pale, atrophic tongue and tender point at L1. What is the most likely pathophysiologic change causing fracture of L1?
questions.explanation:
Estrogen deficiency — หญิงหลังหมดประจำเดือน vertebral compression fracture จากแรงกระแทกเบา = fragility fracture จาก postmenopausal osteoporosis: estrogen ↓ → RANKL ↑ OPG ↓ → bone resorption ↑
Trap: ซีด/ลิ้นฝ่อ (iron/B12) และ BMI ต่ำเป็นปัจจัยเสริม ไม่ใช่กลไกหลัก

questions.stem: A 45-year-old man with type 2 diabetes has been prescribed glibenclamide for blood glucose control. Which of the following choices is the effect of this drug on pancreatic ß cell?

options.B: Insulin granules are secreted by voltage-gated channel

questions.explanation:
Pancreatic β-cell membrane depolarization — glibenclamide จับ SUR1 → ปิด K-ATP → depolarization → voltage-gated Ca²⁺ เปิด → Ca²⁺ ↑ → insulin exocytosis
Trap: K-ATP ถูก 'ปิด' ไม่ใช่ activate
⚠️ เฉลยขัดกับ AI

questions.stem: Which of the following lipoprotein particles increased when Apo E is abnormal?
questions.explanation:
IDL — apoE ผิดปกติ (E2/E2) → remnant (IDL, chylomicron remnant) จับ LDL receptor/LRP ไม่ได้ → type III dysbetalipoproteinemia
Trap: chylomicron remnant ก็เพิ่มด้วย
⚠️ chylomicron (remnant) ก็เพิ่มขึ้นใน apoE defect

questions.stem: Which of the following is the first line drug for postmenopausal women at high risk of fractures?
questions.explanation:
Alendronate — first-line ของ postmenopausal osteoporosis ที่เสี่ยง fracture สูง = oral bisphosphonate (alendronate, risedronate); ถ้ากินไม่ได้ใช้ zoledronate/denosumab; very high risk ใช้ teriparatide
Trap: calcitonin ฤทธิ์อ่อน

questions.stem: A 35-year-old female presented with a 6-month history of an 8 kg body weight gain and gradual rounding of the face. Serial examinations revealed a loss of circadian rhythm of cortisol, elevated urinary free cortisol level and undetectable plasma ACTH level (<5 pg./mL). What is the most likely cause in this patient?
questions.explanation:
Adrenal adenoma — cortisol สูง + circadian หาย + ACTH < 5 (ถูกกด) = ACTH-independent Cushing → adrenal adenoma
Trap: pituitary tumor และ ectopic ACTH (small cell, carcinoid) มี ACTH สูง

questions.stem: A 10-day-old boy presents with dehydration. PE: weight 2.9 kg (birthweight 3.2 kg), dry lips, skin hyperpigmentation. Lab: Na 125, K 6.5, CO2 15 mEq/L, serum 17-hydroxyprogesterone 5,500 ng/dl (normal <300). Which is the gross finding of adrenal glands in this patient?
questions.explanation:
Bilateral diffuse enlargement — ทารก salt wasting (Na ↓ K ↑ acidosis) + hyperpigmentation + 17-OHP สูงมาก = 21-hydroxylase deficiency → cortisol ↓ → ACTH ↑ → ต่อมหมวกไตโตทั้งสองข้างแบบ diffuse (cerebriform)
Trap: atrophy พบใน autoimmune Addison

questions.stem: A 40-year-old woman presents with tiredness, anorexia and weakness for 1 year. PE: BP 86/60 mmHg, P 72/min, Skin hyperpigmentation. Lab: Na 128, K 6.5, CO2 16 mmol/L, morning serum cortisol 2.5 ug/dl (normal 5-18) and ACTH 225 pg/mL (normal 9-60). Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanation:
Addison's disease — อ่อนเพลีย BP ต่ำ hyperpigmentation + Na ↓ K ↑ acidosis + cortisol ต่ำ ACTH สูงมาก = primary adrenal insufficiency
Trap: Sheehan (secondary) ACTH ต่ำ ไม่มี hyperpigmentation; Waterhouse-Friderichsen เป็น acute (meningococcemia)

questions.stem: A 12-year-old girl was brought to a hospital with abdominal pain and eruptive xanthomas. Her fasting serum revealed milky. Which of the following choices is the most likely cause of this situation?

options.A: Chylomicron remnant cannot uptake into the liver
options.B: Chylomicron is not synthesized in the intestine
options.C: Cholesterol cannot efflux from peripheral cells to HDL
options.D: IDL cannot uptake into the liver
options.E: Triacylglyceride in VLDL is not hydrolyzed

questions.explanation:
Triacylglyceride in VLDL is not hydrolyzed — เด็ก ปวดท้อง (pancreatitis) + eruptive xanthoma + fasting serum ขุ่นเป็นน้ำนม = familial chylomicronemia (type I): LPL/apoC-II deficiency → TG ใน chylomicron (และ VLDL) ไม่ถูกย่อย
Trap: remnant uptake ผิดปกติ (type III) ทำ palmar/tuberoeruptive xanthoma ในผู้ใหญ่ serum ไม่ขุ่นมากแบบนี้
⚠️ ไม่มีช้อยส์ที่ตรงที่สุด (TG ใน chylomicron ไม่ถูกย่อย) · เฉลยขัดกับ AI

questions.stem: Which of the following could occur if methimazole is prescribed in a 6-week pregnant patient with thyrotoxicosis?
questions.explanation:
Teratogenicity — methimazole ในไตรมาสแรก (6 สัปดาห์) → embryopathy: aplasia cutis, choanal/esophageal atresia → ใช้ PTU ในไตรมาสแรก
Trap: liver failure เป็น ADR ของ PTU

questions.stem: Which of the following lipoprotein particles involved in storing fat after eating a meal?
questions.explanation:
Chylomicron — หลังอาหาร enterocyte สร้าง chylomicron ขน TG จากอาหาร → LPL ที่ adipose ปล่อย FFA ให้เก็บเป็น TG
Trap: VLDL ขน TG ที่ตับสร้างในภาวะอดอาหาร/ระหว่างมื้อ

questions.stem: Which of the following hormones helps to cope with the long-term stressors?
questions.explanation:
Glucocorticoids — stress ระยะยาว: cortisol เพิ่ม gluconeogenesis, lipolysis, protein catabolism, กดการอักเสบ รักษาระดับ glucose และ BP
Trap: catecholamine รับมือ stress ระยะสั้น (fight-or-flight)

questions.stem: A 30-year-old man was diagnosed with pituitary tumor- associated acromegaly. Which of the following drugs is most likely prescribed?
questions.explanation:
Octreotide — acromegaly ที่ผ่าตัดไม่หาย/ผ่าตัดไม่ได้: somatostatin analog (octreotide, lanreotide) ยับยั้ง GH; pegvisomant ปิด GH receptor
Trap: somatropin = GH, mecasermin = IGF-1 (ทำให้แย่ลง)

questions.stem: What is the principal cause of metabolic acidosis of diabetes mellitus?
questions.explanation:
Increased lipolysis — insulin ขาด + glucagon เด่น → hormone-sensitive lipase ↑ → FFA ไปตับ → β-oxidation → ketone bodies (acetoacetate, β-hydroxybutyrate) → high anion gap metabolic acidosis
Trap: gluconeogenesis และ glycogenolysis เพิ่มขึ้น

questions.stem: Which of the following hormone levels would be compatible with hyperthyroidism due to Graves' disease?

options.A: High TSH but low T4 levels
options.C: High T4 but low T3 levels
options.D: Low TSH but high T4 levels

questions.explanation:
Low TSH but high T4 levels — Graves: TSI กระตุ้น TSH receptor → T4/T3 ↑ → negative feedback กด TSH
Trap: TSH สูง + T4 สูง = TSH-secreting adenoma หรือ thyroid hormone resistance

questions.stem: Which of the following results is mediated by a hormone released by the posterior pituitary gland?

options.A: Maturation of the eggs and sperms

questions.explanation:
Increased water reabsorption — posterior pituitary หลั่ง ADH (→ V2 → aquaporin-2 ที่ collecting duct) และ oxytocin
Trap: gametogenesis (FSH/LH), adrenal (ACTH), thyroid (TSH) มาจาก anterior pituitary; calcitonin มาจาก thyroid C cell

questions.stem: What is the standard predictor for fragility fracture?

options.B: Bone mass density at femoral neck in T-score
options.C: Bone mass density at lumbar spine in Z-score

questions.explanation:
Bone mineral density at femoral neck in T-score — WHO ใช้ BMD (DXA) T-score ≤ −2.5 ที่ femoral neck เป็นมาตรฐานวินิจฉัยและพยากรณ์ fracture; FRAX ใช้ประเมิน 10-year probability ร่วมกับ BMD
Trap: Z-score ใช้ในเด็ก/ก่อนหมดประจำเดือน
⚠️ เฉลยขัดกับ AI

questions.stem: After a car crash, the axons passing through the pituitary stalk were damaged. This damage could be expected to result in an increased releasing level of which of the following hormones?
questions.explanation:
Prolactin — stalk ขาด → dopamine (PIH) จาก hypothalamus มาไม่ถึง lactotroph → prolactin ↑ (stalk effect) ส่วนฮอร์โมนอื่นของ anterior pituitary ลดลง; ADH/oxytocin ลด (DI)
Trap: prolactin เป็นฮอร์โมนเดียวที่ถูกควบคุมแบบยับยั้งเป็นหลัก

questions.stem: The laboratory results of the patient showed as the following: What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanation:
Diabetes mellitus — 2-h OGTT 227 mg/dL (≥ 200) วินิจฉัย DM ได้เลย แม้ FPG 122 จะอยู่ในช่วง IFG
Trap: IGT คือ 2-h 140–199

questions.stem: A 47-year-old man has lump at neck for 2 months. PE: rubbery-firm nodule in the right thyroid lobe. The cytologic smear from fine needle aspiration reveals groups of follicular cells having nuclear inclusions and nuclear grooves. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanation:
Papillary carcinoma — FNA: nuclear groove, intranuclear pseudoinclusion, Orphan Annie eye nuclei, psammoma body = papillary thyroid carcinoma
Trap: follicular carcinoma วินิจฉัยจาก capsular/vascular invasion ไม่ใช่ลักษณะนิวเคลียส

questions.stem: A 45-year-old woman presented with a 4-year history of progressive increase in body size and a 6-week history of worsening symptoms of heart failure. Physical examination showed coarse facial features, protruding jaw, and enlarged hands and feet. On skull radiograph, destruction of the floor of the pituitary fossa with an erosion of the clinoid processes was noted.
questions.explanation:
Somatotroph — acromegaly (coarse face, prognathism, มือเท้าโต, cardiomyopathy → heart failure) + sella ถูกกัดกร่อน = GH-secreting somatotroph macroadenoma
Trap: mammotroph adenoma พบบ่อยสุดแต่ทำให้ galactorrhea/hypogonadism

questions.stem: Gemfibrozil increases lipoprotein lipase synthesis resulting in the reduction of which substance?
questions.explanation:
Triglyceride — gemfibrozil (fibrate) = PPAR-α agonist → LPL synthesis ↑, apoC-III ↓ → TG ↓ 30–50% (HDL ↑ เล็กน้อย)
Trap: apoC-III ลดลงจริง แต่เป็นกลไก ไม่ใช่ 'ผลจาก LPL ↑'

questions.stem: Which of the following drugs decrease LDL-c by decreasing intestinal cholesterol absorption?
questions.explanation:
Ezetimibe — ยับยั้ง NPC1L1 ที่ brush border → ดูดซึม cholesterol ลดลง → LDL ↓ ~20%
Trap: colesevelam จับ bile acid (ไม่ได้ยับยั้งการดูดซึม cholesterol โดยตรง)

questions.stem: Which of the following signs and symptoms would be found in a patient with low TSH and thyroid hormone levels?
questions.explanation:
Easily fatigued — TSH ต่ำ + TH ต่ำ = central (secondary) hypothyroidism → อ่อนเพลีย เฉื่อย ทนหนาวไม่ได้
Trap: weight loss, heat intolerance, palpitation, exophthalmos เป็นของ hyperthyroid

questions.stem: Which of the following antidiabetic drug is the most likely cause of lactic acidosis?
questions.explanation:
Metformin — biguanide ยับยั้ง hepatic gluconeogenesis จาก lactate → lactic acidosis (พบน้อยแต่รุนแรง เสี่ยงใน CKD, hypoxia)
Trap: sulfonylurea (glipizide, chlorpropamide) → hypoglycemia

questions.stem: A 60-year-old man presents with severe headache PE: BP 180/100 mmHg, P 80/min. Lab: serum cortisol at 8 am 15 ug/dL (normal 6 - 23), plasma renin activity 1.2 ng/mL/hr (normal 1.9 - 3.7), serum aldosterone 44 ng/dL (normal 4.0 - 31.0), serum potassium 2.5 mmol/L. CT scan: a 2-cm mass at left adrenal gland. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanation:
Cortical adenoma — HT + hypokalemia + aldosterone ↑ renin ↓ + ก้อน 2 cm = aldosterone-producing adrenocortical adenoma (Conn syndrome)
Trap: carcinoma มักก้อน > 4–6 cm; pheochromocytoma มี catecholamine excess

questions.stem: A patient with asthma has been taking a steroidal anti-inflammatory drug for a prolonged period. Which of the following is likely to occur in hypothalamic and pituitary hormones release?
questions.explanation:
Low corticotropin-releasing hormone — glucocorticoid ภายนอก (prednisolone) → negative feedback กด CRH และ ACTH → adrenal atrophy (หยุดยาทันทีเสี่ยง adrenal crisis)
Trap: ACTH ต่ำ ไม่ใช่สูง

questions.stem: A 45-year-old man has a femoral neck fracture after receiving prednisolone for 6 months. What is the most likely mechanism explaining his fracture?
questions.explanation:
Increase osteoblast apoptosis — glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis: osteoblast differentiation ↓ + apoptosis ↑ (กลไกหลัก), RANKL ↑ OPG ↓, Ca absorption ↓
Trap: osteocalcin และ OPG ลดลง

questions.stem: A 20-year-old woman has xanthomas over the knees, the wrists, and elbows. Her serum LDL cholesterol is 500 mg/dL with HDL cholesterol of 40 mg/dL. She was diagnosed as having myocardial infarction recently. What is the mechanism of her dyslipidemia?
questions.explanation: Decreased receptor-mediated endocytosis of LDL — LDL 500 + tendon xanthoma + MI อายุน้อย = familial hypercholesterolemia: LDL receptor (หรือ apoB/PCSK9) ผิดปกติ → ตับจับ LDL ไม่ได้

questions.stem: A 37-year-old woman presented with palpitations, shortness of breath and headache. On physical examination, her heart rate was 110 bpm and the blood pressure was 170/110 mmHg. The laboratory results of plasma sodium and potassium showed as the following. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanation:
Primary hyperaldosteronism — HT รุนแรงในหญิงอายุน้อย + (คาดว่า) K ต่ำ Na ปกติ/สูง = primary hyperaldosteronism
Trap: ถ้า Na ต่ำ K สูงจะเป็น adrenal insufficiency/CAH บางชนิด
⚠️ ตารางผล Na/K หายไปจากต้นฉบับ ตอบได้ไม่แน่นอน · ในเฉลยต้นฉบับไม่ได้วงคำตอบ (เขียนว่าโจทย์ไม่ครบ) · ไม่มีเฉลยต้นฉบับ AI ทำเฉลยให้

questions.stem: Which of the following is a main mechanism of glyburide (glibenclamide) lower blood glucose levels?

options.B: Promote glucose uptake by muscle, liver, and adipose tissue
options.D: Decrease insulin resistance by lowering body weight

questions.explanation:
Release insulin from the pancreas — glyburide (glibenclamide) เป็น sulfonylurea = insulin secretagogue
Trap: B = metformin/TZD, C = SGLT2i, D = GLP-1 RA

questions.stem: Which of the following molecules is decreased in postmenopausal women and led to osteoporosis?
questions.explanation:
OPG — estrogen ↓ → OPG ↓ และ RANKL ↑ → RANKL/OPG ratio ↑ → osteoclastogenesis ↑
Trap: RANKL เพิ่มขึ้น (ไม่ใช่ลดลง)

questions.stem: Which of the following mechanisms involved in glucose homeostasis during fed state?

options.A: Increased glucose uptake in brain tissue
options.E: Increased glucose uptake in muscle tissue

questions.explanation:
Increased glucose uptake in muscle tissue — fed state: insulin → GLUT4 translocation ที่ muscle/adipose + hepatic glycogenesis
Trap: hepatic glucose production และ glycogenolysis ลดลง

questions.stem: Which of the following conditions increases plasma insulin levels?
questions.explanation:
Following a carbohydrate-rich meal — glucose + incretin → insulin ↑
Trap: hypoglycemia, somatostatin, exercise, surgical stress ลด insulin

questions.stem: The combination of simvastatin and which drug may increase risk of statin-associated myopathy?
questions.explanation:
Ketoconazole — strong CYP3A4 inhibitor → ระดับ simvastatin ↑ หลายเท่า → myopathy/rhabdomyolysis
Trap: rifampicin เป็น inducer (ลดระดับ statin)

questions.stem: Which of the following laboratory results indicates the highest risk of coronary heart disease?

options.A: HDL-C = 30 mg/dL and Total cholesterol = 260 mg/dL
options.B: HDL-c = 60 mg/dL and Total cholesterol = 190 mg/dL
options.C: HDL-c = 55 mg/dL and Total cholesterol = 170 mg/dL
options.D: HDL-C = 35 mg/dL and Total cholesterol = 220 mg/dL
options.E: HDL-C = 40 mg/dL and Total cholesterol = 180 mg/dL

questions.explanation:
HDL-C 30, TC 260 — risk สูงสุดเมื่อ HDL ต่ำสุดและ TC สูงสุด: non-HDL 230 mg/dL, TC/HDL ratio 8.7
Trap: เทียบด้วย TC/HDL หรือ non-HDL ไม่ใช่ดูค่าเดียว

questions.stem: A 30-yr-old female presented with significant weight gain, dry skin, hair loss, milky discharge and goiter. The laboratory test showed FT4 0.2 ng/dL (0.7-1.4), TSH > 100 mlU/L (0.5-5), Prolactin 110 mcg/L (0-25). What is the mechanism of hyperprolactinemia?
questions.explanation:
High TRH — primary hypothyroidism (FT4 ต่ำ TSH > 100) → TRH จาก hypothalamus ↑ → กระตุ้น lactotroph → prolactin ↑ → galactorrhea; TSH สูงมากทำให้ pituitary โต (อาจคล้าย adenoma)
Trap: รักษา hypothyroid แล้ว prolactin ลดเอง

questions.stem: A 45-year-old man with type 2 diabetes presents with unconsciousness and plasma glucose level of 41 mg/dL. Which of the following drugs is most likely to cause hypoglycemia?
questions.explanation:
Glibenclamide — sulfonylurea กระตุ้น insulin โดยไม่ขึ้นกับ glucose → hypoglycemia รุนแรงได้ (ออกฤทธิ์ยาว)
Trap: exenatide, pramlintide, pioglitazone, voglibose แทบไม่ทำให้ hypoglycemia เมื่อใช้เดี่ยว

questions.stem: What is the diagnosis in a patient who has hyperglycemia from total pancreatectomy and requires insulin injection?
questions.explanation:
Other specific type of diabetes — DM จาก pancreatectomy = disease of exocrine pancreas (type 3c) ใน ADA classification
Trap: แม้ต้องใช้ insulin ก็ไม่ใช่ T1DM

questions.stem: Which of the following mechanisms involved in normalizing plasma glucose in subjects with insulin resistance?

options.E: Increased glucose uptake in brain tissue

questions.explanation:
Increased insulin secretion — insulin resistance: β-cell หลั่ง insulin มากขึ้น (compensatory hyperinsulinemia) → glucose ปกติจนกว่า β-cell ล้า
Trap: glucosuria เกิดเมื่อ glucose > 180 mg/dL

questions.stem: A 40-yr-old female presented with Cushingoid appearance. After taking dexamethasone 1 mg at 11 pm, the result is very high morning cortisol in the following day. What is the mechanism of this result?

options.D: Interference of cortisol assay by dexamethasone

questions.explanation:
Loss of negative feedback — overnight 1-mg dexamethasone suppression: คนปกติ cortisol เช้า < 1.8 µg/dL; Cushing ไม่ถูกกด (autonomous cortisol/ACTH) = สูญเสีย negative feedback
Trap: loss of circadian rhythm ดูจาก late-night cortisol

questions.stem: Which of the followings acts as a tropic hormone from anterior pituitary gland?
questions.explanation:
Luteinizing hormone — tropic hormone จาก anterior pituitary: LH, FSH, TSH, ACTH (GH บางส่วน)
Trap: TRH, CRH, PIH (dopamine) เป็นของ hypothalamus; cortisol จาก adrenal

questions.stem: Which enzyme is important for signal transduction of growth hormone receptors?

options.B: Janus kinase/signal transducer and activator of transcription

questions.explanation:
JAK/STAT — GH receptor เป็น cytokine receptor (ไม่มี intrinsic kinase) → JAK2 phosphorylate → STAT5 → IGF-1 transcription
Trap: insulin/IGF-1 receptor เป็น receptor tyrosine kinase

questions.stem: A 20-year-old female patient was diagnosed with Addison's disease. She is treated with hydrocortisone but still has hyponatremia. Which of the following medications should be added to this patient?
questions.explanation:
Fludrocortisone — Addison ขาดทั้ง cortisol และ aldosterone; hydrocortisone มี mineralocorticoid activity ไม่พอ → เพิ่ม fludrocortisone แก้ hyponatremia/hyperkalemia
Trap: dexamethasone/prednisolone แทบไม่มี mineralocorticoid activity

questions.stem: The 50-year-old woman presented with headache, palpitation, sweating, pallor, tremor and abdominal discomfort. Her clinical features suggested pheochromocytoma. Which of the following laboratory tests should be further investigation?
questions.explanation:
Urine vanillylmandelic acid — pheochromocytoma: ตรวจ catecholamine metabolites (plasma free/urine metanephrines ไวสุด, VMA) → แล้วจึงทำ CT/MRI
Trap: ACTH, cortisol, aldosterone เป็นการตรวจ Cushing/Conn

questions.stem: A 23-year-old man presented with nausea and vomiting. Laboratory results revealed plasma fasting glucose 420 mg/dL (N 70 - 99 mg/dL), plasma HCO3-6 mmol/L (N 22 - 26 mmol/L), and urine ketone with 4+. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanation:
Diabetic ketoacidosis — glucose 420 + HCO₃⁻ 6 (severe metabolic acidosis) + urine ketone 4+ = DKA (มัก T1DM ผู้ป่วยอายุน้อย)
Trap: HHS ketone น้อยและ pH > 7.30

questions.stem: A female patient with Cushing's syndrome complains of hirsutism and acne after receiving a drug for inhibiting cortisol synthesis. Which of the followings is she most likely taken?
questions.explanation:
Metyrapone — ยับยั้ง 11β-hydroxylase (CYP11B1) → cortisol ↓ → ACTH ↑ → precursor ไปทาง adrenal androgen → hirsutism, acne; 11-deoxycorticosterone ↑ → HT
Trap: ketoconazole ยับยั้งหลายขั้นรวมทั้ง androgen synthesis (ไม่ทำ hirsutism)

questions.stem: Which of the following choices is a receptor responsible for paracrine hormone induction of osteoclastogenesis?
questions.explanation:
RANK — RANKL (paracrine จาก osteoblast/osteocyte) จับ receptor RANK บน osteoclast precursor → NF-κB → osteoclastogenesis
Trap: RANKL เป็น ligand ไม่ใช่ receptor; OPG เป็น decoy receptor ที่ยับยั้ง

questions.stem: A 58-year-old man had a thyroid cancer removal. Six months later, he had a regular medical check-up. The doctor mentioned that he had an abnormal calcium level (1.5 mmol/L). Which of the following signs/symptoms might be observed?
questions.explanation:
Tetany — หลังผ่าตัด thyroid → hypoparathyroidism → hypocalcemia (ปกติ 2.2–2.6 mmol/L) → tetany, Chvostek, Trousseau
Trap: kidney stone, constipation เป็นอาการ hypercalcemia
⚠️ ค่า calcium ในต้นฉบับเขียนซ้อนกัน (2.0 1.5 mmol/L)

questions.stem: A 3-year-old girl presented with bone pain, abnormal bone shape and slow growth rate. The doctor informed parents that she had hypophosphatemic condition due to a massive loss of phosphate in the urine. Which of the followings might relate to her signs and symptoms?

options.C: Increased IIa Na+/Pi cotransporter expression in the kidneys
options.D: Increased IIb Na+/Pi cotransporter expression in the intestine

questions.explanation:
Increased 24(OH)ase expression in the kidneys — X-linked hypophosphatemic rickets: PHEX mutation → FGF-23 ↑ → NaPi-IIa/IIc ↓ (phosphate wasting) + 1α-hydroxylase ↓ + 24-hydroxylase ↑ → calcitriol ↓
Trap: FGF-23 เพิ่มขึ้น (ไม่ใช่ลดลง)

questions.stem: A 50-year-old man comes for check-up. Laboratory findings: serum calcium 12 mg/dL (normal 8.0-9.5), phosphate 2.8 mg/dL (normal 3.5-5.5), parathyroid hormone 70 ng/L (normal 10-65). Which of the following condition/disease the patient is most likely to have?
questions.explanation:
Nodule in one parathyroid gland — Ca สูง PO₄ ต่ำ PTH สูง = primary hyperparathyroidism → สาเหตุ ~85% คือ parathyroid adenoma ต่อมเดียว
Trap: hyperplasia ทั้ง 4 ต่อมพบใน secondary (CKD) หรือ MEN; CKD มี PO₄ สูง

questions.stem: Which of the following processes would be most affected in lecithin cholesterol acyl transferase (LCAT) deficiency?

options.A: Binding of LDL to its receptor
options.B: Conversion of discoidal HDL to HDL3
options.D: Uptake of HDL into the liver
options.E: Transfer of cholesterol from LDL to peripheral tissues

questions.explanation:
Conversion of discoidal HDL to HDL3 — LCAT esterify cholesterol บน nascent HDL → cholesteryl ester เข้าแกน → discoidal กลายเป็น spherical HDL3 → HDL2
Trap: CE-TG exchange เป็นของ CETP

questions.stem: Which of the following glucose transporters plays a central role in glucose tolerance?
questions.explanation:
GLUT4 — glucose tolerance หลังกินกลูโคสขึ้นกับ insulin-stimulated glucose uptake ผ่าน GLUT4 ที่ skeletal muscle (~80% ของ glucose disposal)
Trap: GLUT2 ทำหน้าที่ glucose sensing ที่ β-cell และตับ
⚠️ GLUT2 (β-cell sensing) ก็มีบทบาทสำคัญ ถ้อยคำกำกวม

questions.stem: After a car crash, the axons passing through the pituitary stalk were damaged. This damage could be expected to result in an increased releasing level of which of the following hormones?
questions.explanation:
Prolactin — stalk ขาด → dopamine ไปไม่ถึง → prolactin ↑ (ข้อซ้ำกับข้อ 21 แต่สลับช้อยส์)
Trap: ฮอร์โมนอื่นของ anterior pituitary ลดลง

questions.stem: Which of the following is a mechanism of aldosterone to trigger cellular response?
questions.explanation:
Forming hormone-receptor complex in cytoplasm — aldosterone (steroid) ผ่าน membrane จับ mineralocorticoid receptor ใน cytoplasm → เข้า nucleus → transcription ของ ENaC, Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase, SGK1
Trap: adenylyl cyclase, PLC, GPCR เป็นของ peptide hormone

questions.stem: Which of the following is the inhibition site of methimazole?
questions.explanation:
Iodine organification — methimazole ยับยั้ง thyroid peroxidase → oxidation ของ iodide, organification, coupling ลดลง
Trap: peripheral conversion (deiodinase) ถูกยับยั้งโดย PTU ไม่ใช่ MMI

questions.stem: The laboratory results of the patient showed as the following: Which of the following LDL-c results should be found in this patient?
questions.explanation:
206 mg/dL — Friedewald: LDL-C = TC − HDL-C − TG/5 = 300 − 50 − 44 = 206 mg/dL (ใช้ได้เมื่อ TG < 400)
Trap: อย่าลืมหาร TG ด้วย 5 (ประมาณ VLDL-C)

questions.stem: Which of the followings is the mechanism of thiazide diuretics on calcium reabsorption in the kidneys?
questions.explanation:
Increased NCX1 activity — thiazide ปิด NCC ที่ DCT → Na⁺ ในเซลล์ ↓ → basolateral NCX1 ขับ Ca²⁺ ออกสู่เลือดมากขึ้น → Ca reabsorption ↑ (TRPV5 ทำงานมากขึ้นด้วย)
Trap: NCC ลดลง (ไม่ใช่เพิ่ม); NKCC2 เป็นเป้าของ loop diuretic

questions.stem: Which of the following drugs is most likely prescribed to decrease testosterone production in patient with prostate cancer?
questions.explanation:
Leuprolide — GnRH agonist ให้ต่อเนื่อง → GnRH receptor down-regulation → LH ↓ → testosterone ↓ (medical castration) ในมะเร็งต่อมลูกหมาก
Trap: urofollitropin = FSH; lanreotide = somatostatin analog

questions.stem: A 20-year-old woman presents with neck pain for 2 days. PE: P 110/min, mild enlargement of thyroid gland with marked tenderness. Lab: free T4 1.90 ng/dL (normal 0.7-1.7), TSH 0.05 mIU/L (normal 0.25-4.00). Which of the following is the pathological characteristic of this thyroid disease?
questions.explanation:
Multinucleated giant cells engulfing colloid — subacute granulomatous (de Quervain) thyroiditis: ปวดคอ ต่อมกดเจ็บ thyrotoxicosis ชั่วคราว → พยาธิ: granuloma + multinucleated giant cell กลืน colloid
Trap: lymphoid follicle with germinal center = Hashimoto; Hurthle cell พบใน Hashimoto/Hurthle cell neoplasm
